title: Creamy Risotto with Nano and Vialone Rice
description: A rich and creamy risotto dish using Nano and Vialone rice, infused with a hint of French spices.
instructions: Heat the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the French onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the Spicy kiss and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the Vialone and Nano rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add the White wine and cook until absorbed, about 2 minutes.
Add 1 cup of Chicken broth and cook, stirring constantly, until absorbed.
Repeat the process of adding the broth in 1 cup increments, until the rice is cooked and creamy, about 20-25 minutes.
Stir in the Gratin cheese until melted.
Season with Salt and Black pepper to taste.
